entry.title: Nov 14, 2026: 5 new models

entry.title: Nov 3, 2026: 1 price change
entry.content: • Nov 3, 2026: Mistral Large 4 price cut: input $1.36 → $0.7 (−49%), output $4.18 → $2.1 (−50%) per 1M tokens. This undid the change of Oct 28, 2026.

entry.title: Oct 28, 2026: 1 price change, 1 new model, 1 retired
entry.content:
• Oct 28, 2026: DeepSeek V4 1 Flash 1017 added to the price list at $0.3 input and $1.2 output per 1M tokens.
  • Oct 28, 2026: Mistral Large 4 price increase: input $0.68 → $1.36 (+100%), output $2.09 → $4.18 (+100%) per 1M tokens. Reversed on Nov 3, 2026, most likely a correction.
  • Oct 28, 2026: Grok Code Fast 1 left the price list (it cost $1 input and $2 output per 1M tokens).
